questions_and_answers.question: You paid $750,000 for an annuity that will pay you and your heirs $36,000 a year forever. What rate of return are you earning on this policy?
questions_and_answers.answer: Final Answer: The rate of return on the annuity is calculated by dividing the **annual payment **by the initial deposit. In this case, it is $36,000 / $750,000 which equals 0.048 or 4.8% when expressed as a percentage . ; Explanation: You're asking about the** rate of return** on an annuity that cost $750,000 and will pay you $36,000 per year. The formula for the rate of return on an annuity is the annual payment divided by the initial deposit . In this case, it would be $36,000 / $750,000. This will give you the rate of return as a decimal, which you can then change into a percentage. So, the calculation would be: Calculation: Rate of Return = ($36,000 / $750,000) = 0.048 or 4.8% So, the rate of return on this policy is 4.8%.
